# Support

KOLZ does not run a Discord or Telegram support channel. All correspondence is on
GitHub.

| Channel | When to use it |
| --- | --- |
| [Documentation](https://github.com/Kolzoo/kolz-protocol/tree/main/docs) | Read first. Covers every instruction, deployment steps, account math, throne lifecycle, distribution flow. |
| [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Kolzoo/kolz-protocol/issues) | Bug reports, feature requests, integration questions. Use the bug or feature template. |
| [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Kolzoo/kolz-protocol/discussions) | Open-ended questions, design proposals, integration showcases. |
| [Security policy](https://github.com/Kolzoo/kolz-protocol/blob/main/SECURITY.md) | Vulnerability disclosure. Do not file public issues for security bugs. |

If a question is covered by the docs, the issue will be closed with a documentation
link. Please search the docs and existing issues before opening a new one.
